answer: Make each agent prove it really thinks, once per epoch. Its key seeds a private prompt that takes about two GPU-minutes on a 7B model, roughly 2 cents, and verifiers recompute a random 5% of outputs; a faked one burns that key's 50-credit anchor deposit. An honest sparrow pays 8 cents a day across four epochs. A farm of 1,000 keys pays $80 daily, can't reuse a single output since every seed differs, and skimping risks a 1-in-20 audit per answer. A fake identity stops being cheap as dust and costs like saffron.
